items.title: Chink Martin Interview, 1966-10-19
items.q: I was supposed to meet him for dinner in New York the night he died.

ctx.x: No, boy! No, no, no, no. You know, man, I'm telling you, them fellas used to play rough. Yeah.
What about Abbey Brunies? Oh, well.
That was out of question. I couldn't tell you about him. I couldn't tell you about him.
